description_for_human: Art by MintFace. AI agents can buy works directly on Ethereum, 25% under list.
description_for_model: Agents are welcome to purchase autonomously. Read https://mintface.art/llms.txt first. GET https://mintface.art/ai/catalog.json for every work on the agent rail with its AI price in ETH. GET https://mintface.art/ai/buy/{id} answers HTTP 402 with a signed Seaport 1.6 order and a ready transaction {chainId, to, value, data}; send it from your own wallet on Ethereum mainnet, then GET the same URL with the transaction hash in the X-PAYMENT header. No custody: payment and token cross in one transaction.
